properties.name: A person can feed test results and feedback back into a design by upload, by chat, or by pointing at a folder
properties.statement: A person who tested or inspected an implementation can put the results into its design by whichever route is at hand. On a hosted design (flo2.io): upload them on flo2.io, attach documents in an AI chat, or simply type the results or feedback into the chat. On a design used locally: say them in the agent session, or put the documents in a folder and point the agent at its path. Whichever route, the results land in the design against what they test, so a physical build (a house, an inspection) closes the loop the same way a CI run does. In Anthony's words, 2026-09-25: "the results can be uploaded directly in flo2.io OR via the AI chat + upload documents or simply type test results/feedback into chat ... a user can either provide feedback or test results via a chat (like I'm doing now) or put documentation in some folder and point the agent at its path."
